About SchoolAI

We make school awesome everyday for students and the people supporting them by finding out what they need and making it happen.

Values
We want everyone at SchoolAI to make a competitive wage, have fun, and do good. As we build out the team, we optimize for, and invest in, great people who:

🪄 Make Magic: You're making magic when you dream big, sweat the details, make the complex look elegant, and the final result is one that puts a smile on everyone's face. People are drawn to working with you and your work.
☀️ Rise to the Moment: You're rising to the moment when you show up, answer the call, make the extra effort, and appreciate the fact that we are working with the coolest technology, in the biggest space it'll impact, and we're in pole position.
🔗 Connect the Dots: You've done the work to prioritize, understand, and tie your work to your team, to students, and to the people who support them. You're driving tangible outcomes and can connect your work to meaningful, tangible business results and goals. You're connecting the dots when you've thought deeply and have a throughline narrative for your work.
🚀 Make High Leverage Bets: Always consider the board in front of you – using data, instinct, honed expertise, and user problems to pick the best move and maximize the impact of every resource. When the moment is right – go all in.
➡️ Simplify and Go: Cut through the noise. Focus on what's essential and act with urgency. Speed is your ally, simplicity your tool. Embrace clarity and let it guide you to swift victories.
We use our core values to make decisions, evaluate work, and win. We expect that every team member demonstrate these values. In turn, we'll invest in you and your impact at SchoolAI.

This is a unique opportunity to join a high-impact team shaping the company's future growth trajectory, with a focus on conversion, adoption, and early retention. You'll be building one of the most exciting engines for crafting AI agents and sophisticated data ontologies in education—work that directly influences the top line of a generational company.

If you thrive in fast-moving environments, are driven by curiosity, and care deeply about delivering measurable results that improve lives, we'd love to work with you.
responsibilities:
What You'll Achieve
Set and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for key areas of our growth flywheel—making resource and prioritization tradeoffs that balance customer needs, speed, and business outcomes.
Drive measurable impact on conversion, adoption, and retention through a steady cadence of experiments, product improvements, and foundational platform work.
Learn from our customers to understand their needs, pain points, and aspirations—and ship features and improvements that meaningfully change their experience.
Tackle diverse challenges ranging from rapid-fire experimentation to longer-term strategic bets, always balancing craft with velocity.
Lead cross-functional squads—including design, engineering, AI research, and data science—through iterative cycles of development, testing, and learning.
Translate complexity into clarity for users, teams, and executives, ensuring alignment on what matters most and why.
Key Responsibilities
Opportunity Identification and Assessment
Identify and evaluate new product opportunities by synthesizing diverse inputs—customer feedback, market trends, internal data—and filtering them through risk, uncertainty, and impact lenses.
Product Ownership and Strategy
Own the full product lifecycle: from ideation and customer discovery to development, launch, and growth.
Align product vision with market realities and company goals, always anticipating risks and unknowns.
Rapid Decision-Making
Make fast, high-quality decisions using just-in-time definitions and work decomposition.
Prioritize eliminating risks and resolving unknowns early to accelerate delivery.
Customer and Market Insight Integration
Gather and quantify customer feedback from multiple sources.
Conduct targeted customer discovery to validate assumptions and shape the product roadmap.
Metrics and Performance Tracking
Define and monitor growth-critical metrics (retention, activation, engagement, revenue attribution).
Use advanced retention frameworks (bracketed, n-day, unbounded) to continuously improve product performance.
Systems and Models for Decision-Making
Develop diagnostic frameworks that enable fast, high-quality decisions across multiple product streams.
keySkills:
Skills You'll Need to Bring
Growth Product Management Expertise: 6–7+ years of relevant experience, with a track record of delivering high-impact product launches and measurable growth outcomes.
Analytical and Strategic Thinking: Skilled at balancing qualitative and quantitative data in decision-making; adept at using prioritization frameworks (Kano, RICE, dollar voting) and risk decomposition models.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to align diverse teams around a clear product vision while confidently exercising decision authority.
Technical Aptitude: Understanding of AI fundamentals (pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, inference, data structures, deep learning basics) and a vision for AI agents in education.
Customer-Centric Mindset: Deep understanding of discovery processes and how to balance user feedback with broader market signals.
Agility and Resilience: Comfortable with ambiguity; thrives in environments that require fast pivots and continuous learning.
Desired Attributes
Innovator at Heart: Passion for experimentation and rapid iteration, turning uncertainty into insight.
Ownership and Accountability: Track record of owning outcomes from concept to delivery.
Bias for Action: Moves quickly and decisively, balancing craft, speed, and measurable results.
Systems Thinker: Sees the connections between decisions, metrics, and long-term outcomes.

About Ontra
Ontra is the leader in AI-powered solutions for the private markets. Powered by industry-leading AI, data from over 2 million contracts, and a global network of legal professionals, Ontra automates critical private market workflows across the fund lifecycle. Ontra's solutions transform unstructured data trapped in static documents into actionable intelligence, enabling firms to accelerate contracts, streamline compliance, and automate entity management. Trusted by more than 1,000 global GPs, investment banks, law firms, and advisors – including nine of the top ten PEI-ranked firms worldwide – Ontra helps firms focus on what's important.

Our Culture
Ontra is a remote-first company that values the power of connection. We find innovative ways to stay connected, both virtually and in person. By promoting ownership, inspiring creativity, and championing collaboration, Ontra enables you to shape your impact and growth. Our commitment to innovation extends beyond our technology; it's embedded in our culture, and AI plays a crucial role in everything we do.

Our culture is one where belonging is the cornerstone of every interaction, rooted in acceptance and respect for all. Our commitment to inclusion begins at the application process, ensuring a fair and equitable hiring experience that values the unique contributions you bring from day one.

About the Role
Ontra is seeking a Senior Product Manager reporting to our Group Product Manager.

To foster team connection and collaboration, this role requires being present in either our Santa Barbara or San Francisco office up to once per quarter for team meetings and off-sites. As such, we are only considering candidates who are currently based in California.

We're looking for someone excited to lead one of our R&D teams as we build the future of our flagship Contract Automation product, with a particular focus on transforming the experience for our sell-side users and sell-side legal network. We're looking for a leader who is thrilled by this challenge—someone who can build a strong, empowered team through change, develop cutting-edge AI and automation solutions, and drive a product strategy that creates indispensable value for our users. If you are a creative and strategic thinker who can connect product initiatives to clear business outcomes and inspire a team to build the future of legal tech, we'd love to get to know you!
responsibilities:
What You'll Do

Lead an Empowered Team: Build and lead a resilient, cross-functional product team of engineering, UX, QE, and data professionals alongside your product trio partners (Eng Manager and UX). You will be tasked with inspiring confidence and curating a psychologically safe environment for your team to navigate change and innovate creatively.

Drive Product Strategy & Vision: Collaborate with product, UX, and engineering leaders to create, promote, and execute a product strategy that achieves our ambitious annual OKRs. You will ensure that your team's priorities have clearly defined goals that align with business outcomes understood across the organization.

Develop Cutting-Edge Solutions: Lead the charge in integrating AI and automation into the core Contract Automation workflow, focusing on solutions to dramatically improve the speed, accuracy, and efficiency of contract processing.

Customer Discovery and Validation: Conduct and drive customer interviews and validation sessions to gather insights that shape product direction.

Execute with Excellence: Translate business objectives into an actionable product roadmap, balancing high-level strategy with hands-on execution to deliver measurable impact. You'll define, track, and share the outcomes of your team's work to demonstrate progress against our goals.

Collaborate to Win: Work closely with Go-To-Market (Sales, Marketing, CS) and Platform teams to ensure seamless product launches, drive adoption, and equip our internal teams with the knowledge they need to succeed.
keySkills:
What You'll Bring

Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, leading cross-functional teams in high-growth B2B SaaS environments. Background in legal tech, contract lifecycle management (CLM), or private markets is a strong plus.

Execution & Delivery: A proven track record of leading products from concept to launch, with full ownership of the product direction and a focus on delivering measurable business outcomes.

Strategic & Analytical Thinking: You are a strategic thinker who connects product initiatives to business goals and uses data, market insights, and user feedback to make informed decisions.

Prioritization: Skilled in creating and executing product priorities that drive measurable business outcomes.

Customer-Centricity: A deep passion for conducting customer discovery, understanding user problems, and translating those insights into impactful product requirements.

AI Familiarity: Passion for using AI to drive efficiency, both in your workflow and through AI/ML-powered product development. Experience developing AI-driven products is a strong plus.

Customer Discovery: Strong ability to conduct customer discovery and effectively translate insights into actionable product requirements.

Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to stakeholders and leadership.

Collaboration: Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and design teams to define scope, prioritize tasks, and deliver results.

Agile Methodology: Comfortable working in agile or iterative development environments.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry.ai is building America's first and only AI-powered super app to radically simplify car ownership. We are redefining how people manage owning a car, one of their most expensive and time-consuming assets. We are the #1 rated and most downloaded app in our category with a 4.7 star rating in the App Store. We have more than 5 million users, and have helped millions find better auto insurance — and we're just getting started.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Jerry.ai's AI driven communications product. AI and automation are a key component of Jerry.ai's growth strategy, driving the engagement, conversion, and retention of our customer base. Today, over 70% of customer requests are handled using AI agents built using our internal AI agent development platform, Propelix. Our goal is to increase this number to over 90%, while increasing customer satisfaction and conversion with AI interactions that delight our customers. The messaging infrastructure underlying these communications across SMS, in-app chat, email, and voice, is critical to the success of the platform, and we need your help to scale it up.
responsibilities:
Who You Are

You have 5+ years of experience in management consulting, technical product management, data analytics, or operations at a fast paced startup. You're a technologist and a systems thinker. You're comfortable in technical conversations and can translate complex ideas into simple terms. You're data-driven, familiar with SQL, and comfortable diving into data to answer your own questions. You like to own metrics, and constantly seek improvement. You're an optimist who asks 'how we can' not 'if we can.' You're passionate about AI. You use it to automate your day to day, you're an early adopter of the latest and greatest, and you want to be at the vanguard of leveraging it at scale to deliver outstanding, personalized customer communications.
keySkills:
How you'll make an impact

Partner closely with our Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to create lovable AI interactions that increase automation and customer satisfaction. Analyze data to identify and prioritize improvements to our core messaging systems. Identify bottlenecks to solving high-impact issues to shape both our prompt engineering best practices and our technical roadmap. Stay on top of AI trends, best practices, and tech to make strategic decisions.
